editorial.title: [사설] 민생도 비전도 없이 물어뜯기만 남은 집권당 전당대회
editorial.body: 입력 더불어민주당 김민석·정청래·송영길 당 대표 후보가 9일 대구에서 열린 순회경선 합동연설회에 참석해 있다. 송봉근 객원기자 집권 여당인 더불어민주당의 당대표를 뽑는 전당대회가 이번 주 최대 당원이 모인 호남과 서울·경기도에서 열리는 등 정점을 향하고 있다. 여당 지도부는 대통령과 함께 국정을 책임질 뿐만 아니라, 정부와 국민을 잇는 역할을 맡는다. 주요 정책과 법안을 정부와 조율하면서 민심과 동떨어진 기조가 나오면 제동을 거는 역할도 담당해야 한다. 하지만 전당대회에서 당대표와 최고위원 후보들의 행태를 보면 이런 역할을 기대하는 것 자체가 무색한 지경이다. 당대표 경선에 나선 김민석·정청래·송영길 후보 간의 공방이 격해지면서 정책과 비전 경쟁은 사라진 지 오래다. 대신 친명이냐, 반명이냐 같은 ‘명심 팔이’와 “배신자” “사당화의 주범” 같은 인신공격이 난무하고 있다. 특히 김 후보와 정 후보의 진흙탕 싸움은 눈을 뜨고 보기 힘든 지경이다. 정 후보가 김 후보의 과거 ‘정몽준 신당’ 합류를 거론하며 배신자라고 비난하고, 김 후보는 ‘명청 갈등’을 집중 부각하며 ‘파묘 경쟁’을 벌이고 있다. 두 후보는 상대를 당 윤리위원회에 제소하겠다고 밝히기도 해 전대 후까지 계파 갈등이 우려되고 있다. 권력투쟁에는 열심이지만 형사소송법 개정안 처리 과정에서 드러난 미비점 보완이나 부동산 세제 개편의 부작용 등 국민의 삶과 직결되는 정책을 둘러싼 진지한 논의는 찾아보기 힘들다. 생중계되는 TV토론회에서도 당대표 후보들은 민생 현안에 대해선 겉핥기식 논의에 그친 반면 상대의 흠집을 부각하며 물어뜯기에 대부분의 시간을 할애했다. 국내 증시 변동성을 키운 단일종목 레버리지 ETF 사태에 대한 반응이 대표적이다. 친청계가 국무총리 출신인 김 후보의 책임론을 거론하자, 친명계가 정 후보의 대표 시절 관련 법 통과를 말했다가 시행령임을 알고 철회했다. 국민 피해가 큰 정책의 대안을 찾기보다 득표전에 써먹을 궁리만 한 셈이다. 고물가·고금리 여파에 폭염까지 겹쳐 민생의 시름은 깊어지고 있다. 정부의 부동산 세제 개편도 전월세 부족 등으로 이어질 조짐이다. 여당 지도부라면 이런 문제의 해법을 놓고 검증을 받아야 할 텐데, 지금 민주당 전대에선 기대하기 어렵다. 강성 당원의 표심을 잡으려는 소모적인 투쟁이 무성하지만 후보들은 당심 위에 민심이 있다는 것을 알아야 한다. 도대체 민주당 후보들이 무엇을 위해 싸우는지 모르겠다는 것이 지금의 민심일 것이다.

editorial.titleTr: Editorial: Ruling Party Convention Devolves Into Infighting as Livelihood and Vision Fall by the Wayside
summaryTr: Policy debates have disappeared from the Democratic Party convention, with only personal attacks running rampant.
The 'mud-slinging' between candidates Kim Min-seok and Jung Chung-rae is a power struggle disconnected from the people's lives.
Instead of solutions to livelihood issues amid high prices and high interest rates, the party is engaged in nothing but a vote-getting competition.
editorial.bodyTr:
The Democratic Party's convention to select a new party chairman is reaching its climax this week with primaries being held in Jeolla, Seoul, and Gyeonggi Province, regions where the largest numbers of party members are concentrated. The ruling party leadership bears responsibility for state affairs alongside the president and must serve as a bridge between the government and the people. They should coordinate major policies and legislation with the government and apply the brakes when positions drift away from public sentiment. However, observing the behavior of chairman and supreme council candidates at the convention makes it futile to expect such a role.

As the primary race intensifies among candidates Kim Min-seok, Jung Chung-rae, and Song Young-gil, policy and vision competition has long disappeared. Instead, attacks pandering to loyalty to the former president—whether one is pro-Moon or anti-Moon—and personal attacks such as "traitor" and "architect of party corruption" have become rampant. The mud-slinging between Kim and Jung candidates in particular is difficult to watch. Jung criticized Kim as a traitor by bringing up his past participation in Jung Mong-joon's new party, while Kim has been intensifying focus on "Moon-Chung conflict" and engaging in "grave-digging competition." The two candidates have even announced plans to file ethics complaints against each other, raising concerns about factional conflict extending beyond the convention. While they are zealous about power struggles, serious discussions on policies directly affecting citizens' lives—such as addressing deficiencies revealed in the criminal procedure law revision process or side effects of real estate tax reform—are nowhere to be found. Even in televised debates broadcast live, party chairman candidates engaged in superficial discussion of livelihood issues while devoting most of their time to attacking each other's weaknesses. The single-stock leveraged ETF crisis that heightened volatility in domestic stock markets is a prime example. When the pro-Jung faction raised questions about responsibility on former Prime Minister Kim, the pro-Moon faction mentioned a related law's passage during Jung's tenure as chairman, only to withdraw after learning it was an executive order. They were simply scheming how to use the issue for vote-getting rather than seeking solutions to policy failures causing major public damage. With high inflation and interest rates compounded by heat waves, public hardship deepens. The government's real estate tax reform also appears likely to lead to shortages in jeonse and monthly rentals. The ruling party leadership should be verified on solutions to these problems, but such expectations are difficult to have from the current Democratic Party convention. While there is considerable wasteful infighting to secure the votes of hardline party members, candidates must understand that public sentiment takes precedence over party sentiment. The current public sentiment is one of bewilderment—not understanding what the Democratic Party candidates are fighting for.

editorials.title: [사설] 민생도 비전도 없이 물어뜯기만 남은 집권당 전당대회
editorials.body: 입력 더불어민주당 김민석·정청래·송영길 당 대표 후보가 9일 대구에서 열린 순회경선 합동연설회에 참석해 있다. 송봉근 객원기자 집권 여당인 더불어민주당의 당대표를 뽑는 전당대회가 이번 주 최대 당원이 모인 호남과 서울·경기도에서 열리는 등 정점을 향하고 있다. 여당 지도부는 대통령과 함께 국정을 책임질 뿐만 아니라, 정부와 국민을 잇는 역할을 맡는다. 주요 정책과 법안을 정부와 조율하면서 민심과 동떨어진 기조가 나오면 제동을 거는 역할도 담당해야 한다. 하지만 전당대회에서 당대표와 최고위원 후보들의 행태를 보면 이런 역할을 기대하는 것 자체가 무색한 지경이다. 당대표 경선에 나선 김민석·정청래·송영길 후보 간의 공방이 격해지면서 정책과 비전 경쟁은 사라진 지 오래다. 대신 친명이냐, 반명이냐 같은 ‘명심 팔이’와 “배신자” “사당화의 주범” 같은 인신공격이 난무하고 있다. 특히 김 후보와 정 후보의 진흙탕 싸움은 눈을 뜨고 보기 힘든 지경이다. 정 후보가 김 후보의 과거 ‘정몽준 신당’ 합류를 거론하며 배신자라고 비난하고, 김 후보는 ‘명청 갈등’을 집중 부각하며 ‘파묘 경쟁’을 벌이고 있다. 두 후보는 상대를 당 윤리위원회에 제소하겠다고 밝히기도 해 전대 후까지 계파 갈등이 우려되고 있다. 권력투쟁에는 열심이지만 형사소송법 개정안 처리 과정에서 드러난 미비점 보완이나 부동산 세제 개편의 부작용 등 국민의 삶과 직결되는 정책을 둘러싼 진지한 논의는 찾아보기 힘들다. 생중계되는 TV토론회에서도 당대표 후보들은 민생 현안에 대해선 겉핥기식 논의에 그친 반면 상대의 흠집을 부각하며 물어뜯기에 대부분의 시간을 할애했다. 국내 증시 변동성을 키운 단일종목 레버리지 ETF 사태에 대한 반응이 대표적이다. 친청계가 국무총리 출신인 김 후보의 책임론을 거론하자, 친명계가 정 후보의 대표 시절 관련 법 통과를 말했다가 시행령임을 알고 철회했다. 국민 피해가 큰 정책의 대안을 찾기보다 득표전에 써먹을 궁리만 한 셈이다. 고물가·고금리 여파에 폭염까지 겹쳐 민생의 시름은 깊어지고 있다. 정부의 부동산 세제 개편도 전월세 부족 등으로 이어질 조짐이다. 여당 지도부라면 이런 문제의 해법을 놓고 검증을 받아야 할 텐데, 지금 민주당 전대에선 기대하기 어렵다. 강성 당원의 표심을 잡으려는 소모적인 투쟁이 무성하지만 후보들은 당심 위에 민심이 있다는 것을 알아야 한다. 도대체 민주당 후보들이 무엇을 위해 싸우는지 모르겠다는 것이 지금의 민심일 것이다.

editorials.titleTr: Editorial: Ruling Party Convention Devolves Into Infighting as Livelihood and Vision Fall by the Wayside
summaryTr: Policy debates have disappeared from the Democratic Party convention, with only personal attacks running rampant.
The 'mud-slinging' between candidates Kim Min-seok and Jung Chung-rae is a power struggle disconnected from the people's lives.

editorials.bodyTr:
The Democratic Party's convention to select a new party chairman is reaching its climax this week with primaries being held in Jeolla, Seoul, and Gyeonggi Province, regions where the largest numbers of party members are concentrated. The ruling party leadership bears responsibility for state affairs alongside the president and must serve as a bridge between the government and the people. They should coordinate major policies and legislation with the government and apply the brakes when positions drift away from public sentiment. However, observing the behavior of chairman and supreme council candidates at the convention makes it futile to expect such a role.

As the primary race intensifies among candidates Kim Min-seok, Jung Chung-rae, and Song Young-gil, policy and vision competition has long disappeared. Instead, attacks pandering to loyalty to the former president—whether one is pro-Moon or anti-Moon—and personal attacks such as "traitor" and "architect of party corruption" have become rampant. The mud-slinging between Kim and Jung candidates in particular is difficult to watch. Jung criticized Kim as a traitor by bringing up his past participation in Jung Mong-joon's new party, while Kim has been intensifying focus on "Moon-Chung conflict" and engaging in "grave-digging competition." The two candidates have even announced plans to file ethics complaints against each other, raising concerns about factional conflict extending beyond the convention. Even in televised debates broadcast live, party chairman candidates engaged in superficial discussion of livelihood issues while devoting most of their time to attacking each other's weaknesses. The single-stock leveraged ETF crisis that heightened volatility in domestic stock markets is a prime example. When the pro-Jung faction raised questions about responsibility on former Prime Minister Kim, the pro-Moon faction mentioned a related law's passage during Jung's tenure as chairman, only to withdraw after learning it was an executive order. The current public sentiment is one of bewilderment—not understanding what the Democratic Party candidates are fighting for.

editorials.body: 입력 2026.08.07 16:46 2026.08.06 18:49 2026.08.04 16:30 윤호중 행정안전부 장관(왼쪽)과 정성호 법무부 장관이 지난 7월 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의에서 대화하고 있다. [연합뉴스] 형사소송법 개정으로 검찰의 수사권이 완전 박탈됨에 따라 현재 가동 중인 9개 검경 합동수사 체제(합수본·합수단·합수부·합수팀)가 9월 말이면 사실상 해체될 전망이다. 마약, 금융증권, 보이스피싱, 가상자산 등 검사가 참여해 경찰과 함께 진행해 온 주요 민생 관련 범죄 수사에도 상당한 차질이 우려된다. 정부는 10월 출범하는 중대범죄수사청(중수청)에 합동수사과 신설을 대안으로 추진 중이지만, 수사권을 박탈당한 검사의 수사 참여는 사실상 불가능해진 만큼 수사의 허점을 메우기 어렵게 됐다. 검사의 합동수사 참여 문제는 지난 5일 이재명 대통령 주재 업무보고에서도 제기됐다. 당시 이 대통령이 “개정된 형소법에 의하면 검사는 수사하면 안 된다고 되어 있느냐”고 묻자 윤호중 행정안전부 장관은 “검사의 직접 수사 권한이 없더라도 수사에 의견 개진은 가능하다”고 답변했다. 하지만 정성호 법무부 장관은 “검사가 수사에 개입하거나 합수본에 참여하는 것은 법적 근거가 취약해 위법 논란과 공소 유지에 문제가 생길 수 있다”고 우려했다. 윤 장관이 언급한 ‘검사 의견 개진’은 지금처럼 검사가 사건을 수사하는 것의 대안이 될 수 없을뿐더러 재판 단계로 가면 검사의 수사 참여가 법정에서 증거 능력을 부정당할 소지가 있다고 법조계는 우려한다. 실제로 법원은 검사의 수사 개시권을 제한한 법령을 위반해 검사가 수사한 사건에 대해 공소기각 판결한 사례가 있다. 이 때문에 법무부와 대검찰청은 법 개정 논의 당시 “검사의 합수본 참여 조항 신설이 필요하다”고 주장했지만, 민주당이 주도한 국회 법제사법위원회에서 묵살됐다. 윤 장관은 공소청과 중수청이 경찰과 함께 하는 ‘공·중·경 합수본’은 가능할 것이라고 말했지만 합법적 대안이 되기 어렵다. 수사권 없이 경찰에 보완수사 요구만 할 수 있는 공소청 검사의 합수본 참여도 위법 시비에 휘말릴 수 있기 때문이다. 정부 일각에선 검찰의 수사 노하우가 사장되지 않도록 검사가 합수본에 참여할 수 있는 법적 근거를 마련하자는 주장도 나온다. 그러나 그런 미봉책보다 범죄자로부터 국민 안전을 크게 위협받게 만든 형소법을 최대한 빨리 재개정하는 것이 순리다.

editorials.titleTr: [Editorial] What Happens to Street Crime Investigations if Nine-Agency Joint Task Force Is Dismantled?
summaryTr: Prosecution's investigative authority stripped by Criminal Procedure Act revision, joint investigation system expected to disband by end of September
Serious concerns over disruptions in investigating crimes affecting people's livelihoods such as drugs, fraud, and virtual assets
Lack of legal grounds for prosecutors' investigative participation makes the Serious Crimes Investigation Division a difficult practical alternative
editorials.bodyTr: With the prosecution's investigative authority completely stripped away by amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act, the nine joint investigation systems currently in operation between prosecutors and police—including joint investigation headquarters, units, departments, and teams—are expected to be virtually dismantled by the end of September. Significant disruptions are anticipated in investigations of major livelihood-related crimes such as drug trafficking, financial securities fraud, voice phishing, and virtual assets, which prosecutors have been conducting jointly with police. The government is pushing ahead with the creation of a joint investigation division under the newly launched Serious Crimes Investigation Agency in October, but since prosecutors will be stripped of investigative authority, their meaningful participation in joint investigations has become virtually impossible, making it difficult to fill gaps in investigative capacity. The issue of prosecutors' participation in joint investigations was raised during a policy briefing chaired by President Lee Jae-myung on the 5th. When the president asked, "According to the amended Criminal Procedure Act, prosecutors are prohibited from conducting investigations, correct?", Minister of Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung responded, "Even without direct investigative authority, prosecutors can still express opinions on investigations." However, Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho expressed concern, saying, "If prosecutors become involved in investigations or participate in joint investigation headquarters, the legal basis is weak and it could raise concerns about illegality and problems in maintaining prosecution." The "expression of opinions by prosecutors" mentioned by Minister Yoon cannot serve as an alternative to prosecutors directly investigating cases as they currently do. Moreover, the legal community is concerned that once cases proceed to trial, prosecutors' involvement in investigations could be subject to challenges regarding evidence admissibility in court. Indeed, courts have ruled to dismiss prosecutions in cases investigated by prosecutors who violated statutes limiting prosecutors' right to initiate investigations. For this reason, the Justice Ministry and the Supreme Prosecutors' Office argued during discussions on legislative amendments that "a provision allowing prosecutors to participate in joint investigation headquarters must be added," but this was ignored by the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, which was led by the Democratic Party. Minister Yoon stated that a joint investigation headquarters involving the Public Investigation Agency and the Serious Crimes Investigation Agency alongside police would be possible, but this hardly constitutes a legitimate alternative. The participation of Public Investigation Agency prosecutors, who can only request supplementary investigations from police without investigative authority, could itself face legal challenges. Some within the government have suggested establishing a legal basis for prosecutors to participate in joint investigation headquarters so that the prosecution's investigative expertise is not lost. However, rather than such stopgap measures, the rational course is to amend the Criminal Procedure Act as quickly as possible, since it has gravely compromised public safety against criminals.

editorial.title: Leveraged ETF fallout
editorial.body: Korea must restore policy credibility after financial populism fuels market turmoil Markets have a habit of exposing political wishful thinking. They can absorb disappointing earnings and slower growth. They are far less forgiving when governments try to rewrite the rules by which prices are set. South Korea's recent stock market turmoil offers a costly reminder. The catalyst was single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds tied to Samsung Electronics and SK hynix. They debuted in late May as enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence and semiconductor shares approached its peak. Instead of merely amplifying investor interest, the products intensified every subsequent decline. Violent swings through June and July triggered automatic liquidations, repeated trading halts and heavy losses for retail investors. Regulators later tightened investment requirements and suspended additional launches, sharply reducing trading activity. Those emergency steps calmed speculation, yet they arrived only after the damage had spread. Many have portrayed the turmoil as another chapter in the global technology correction or the semiconductor cycle. Those forces clearly mattered. But they do not explain why Korea’s benchmark index became one of the world's most turbulent major equity markets within weeks. The answer lies partly in market structure. Samsung Electronics and SK hynix already dominate the benchmark index. Introducing derivatives that doubled daily price movements concentrated even greater pressure on an already narrow market. Daily portfolio rebalancing and margin requirements then reinforced each decline. Falling prices prompted forced selling, which drove prices lower and generated fresh liquidations, creating a feedback loop that spread well beyond the semiconductor sector. What began as a correction in a handful of stocks distorted price formation across the broader market. This turned an ordinary downturn into a painful breakdown in market stability. The authorities' response inadvertently made the point. They accelerated plans to raise the minimum cash deposit from 10 million won ($7,050) to 30 million won, examined portfolio exposure limits and halted new listings of similar products. Those measures were sensible. They also suggested that safeguards deserved closer scrutiny before the products ever reached investors. Equally troubling is the speed with which such a consequential policy reached the market. Opposition parties have demanded investigations, while criticism has spread beyond partisan lines. Even figures broadly aligned with the Lee Jae Myung administration have called for a closer examination of the approval process for the leveraged ETFs. The issue extends beyond one financial product. Transparent decision-making is essential because trust in financial supervision depends as much on institutional independence as regulatory expertise. When policy initiatives appear to originate in political offices while regulators adjust course afterward, the boundary between oversight and political direction inevitably becomes blurred. Foreign media’s portrayal of Korea as an unpredictable investment destination may overstate the case, and government officials are right to point to robust exports, healthy corporate earnings and solid macroeconomic indicators. Yet sound fundamentals cannot fully offset doubts created when financial rules appear vulnerable to shifting political priorities rather than consistent regulatory judgment. That distinction matters because the “Korea discount” has never reflected corporate performance alone. Investors evaluate the credibility of policymaking. Sudden regulatory shifts, emergency interventions and uncertainty over who ultimately directs financial oversight inevitably raise the premium global investors demand. A transparent review of how single-stock leveraged ETFs won approval would therefore strengthen the market rather than weaken it. It should clarify whether internal objections received adequate consideration and whether institutional safeguards functioned as intended. Speculative enthusiasm can lift share prices for a time, but lasting gains depend on institutional credibility. The government is moving to stabilize markets and rebuild confidence. Assuming belated measures can quickly restore trust would itself be another form of political wishful thinking. Former Prime Minister narrowly leads ruling party leadership race Rep. 많은 사람들이 이 혼란을 글로벌 기술주 조정이나 반도체 사이클의 또 다른 장으로 묘사했다. 이러한 요인들이 명백히 영향을 미쳤다. 그러나 한국의 벤치마크 지수가 수주 내에 세계에서 가장 변동성 높은 주요 주식시장 중 하나가 된 이유를 설명하지는 못한다. 답은 부분적으로 시장 구조에 있다. 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스는 이미 벤치마크 지수를 지배하고 있다. 일일 가격 변동을 두 배로 증폭시키는 파생상품을 도입하는 것은 이미 좁은 시장에 더욱 큰 압력을 집중시켰다. 일일 포트폴리오 리밸런싱과 증거금 요건은 각 하락을 강화했다. 가격 하락이 강제 매도를 촉발했고, 이것이 가격을 더욱 낮추고 새로운 청산을 야기해 반도체 부문을 훨씬 넘어 확산되는 악순환을 만들었다. 소수 종목의 조정으로 시작한 것이 광범위한 시장에서 가격 형성을 왜곡했다. 이는 통상적인 하락을 고통스러운 시장 안정성 붕괴로 전환시켰다.

당국의 대응은 우연히 그 문제를 드러냈다. 그들은 최소 현금 예치금을 천만 원에서 삼천만 원으로 인상하고, 포트폴리오 노출 한도를 검토하며, 유사 상품의 신규 상장을 중단하는 계획을 가속화했다. 이러한 조치들은 타당했다. 또한 이들은 상품이 투자자에게 도달하기 전에 안전장치가 더 면밀한 검토를 받을 자격이 있음을 시사했다. 마찬가지로 문제가 되는 점은 이러한 중대한 정책이 시장에 도달한 속도이다. 야당은 조사를 요구했으며, 비판은 당파적 선을 넘어 확산되었다. 이준석 정부와 광범위하게 일치하는 인물들조차 레버리지 ETF 승인 절차에 대한 더 면밀한 검토를 촉구했다.

따라서 단일주식 레버리지 ETF 승인 방식에 대한 투명한 검토는 시장을 약화시키기보다는 강화할 것이다. 내부 이의가 충분한 고려를 받았는지, 그리고 제도적 안전장치가 의도대로 작동했는지를 명확히 해야 한다. 투기적 열기는 한때 주가를 올릴 수 있지만, 지속적인 이득은 제도적 신뢰성에 달려있다. 정부는 시장을 안정화하고 신뢰를 회복하기 위해 조치를 취하고 있다. 늦은 조치들이 신뢰를 빠르게 회복할 수 있다고 가정하는 것은 그 자체로 또 다른 형태의 정치적 낙관론이다.

editorials.title: Leveraged ETF fallout
editorials.body: Korea must restore policy credibility after financial populism fuels market turmoil Markets have a habit of exposing political wishful thinking. They can absorb disappointing earnings and slower growth. They are far less forgiving when governments try to rewrite the rules by which prices are set. South Korea's recent stock market turmoil offers a costly reminder. The catalyst was single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds tied to Samsung Electronics and SK hynix. They debuted in late May as enthusiasm surrounding artificial intelligence and semiconductor shares approached its peak. Instead of merely amplifying investor interest, the products intensified every subsequent decline. Violent swings through June and July triggered automatic liquidations, repeated trading halts and heavy losses for retail investors. Regulators later tightened investment requirements and suspended additional launches, sharply reducing trading activity. Those emergency steps calmed speculation, yet they arrived only after the damage had spread. Many have portrayed the turmoil as another chapter in the global technology correction or the semiconductor cycle. Those forces clearly mattered. But they do not explain why Korea’s benchmark index became one of the world's most turbulent major equity markets within weeks. The answer lies partly in market structure. Samsung Electronics and SK hynix already dominate the benchmark index. Introducing derivatives that doubled daily price movements concentrated even greater pressure on an already narrow market. Daily portfolio rebalancing and margin requirements then reinforced each decline. Falling prices prompted forced selling, which drove prices lower and generated fresh liquidations, creating a feedback loop that spread well beyond the semiconductor sector. What began as a correction in a handful of stocks distorted price formation across the broader market. This turned an ordinary downturn into a painful breakdown in market stability. The authorities' response inadvertently made the point. They accelerated plans to raise the minimum cash deposit from 10 million won ($7,050) to 30 million won, examined portfolio exposure limits and halted new listings of similar products. Those measures were sensible. They also suggested that safeguards deserved closer scrutiny before the products ever reached investors. Equally troubling is the speed with which such a consequential policy reached the market. Opposition parties have demanded investigations, while criticism has spread beyond partisan lines. Even figures broadly aligned with the Lee Jae Myung administration have called for a closer examination of the approval process for the leveraged ETFs. The issue extends beyond one financial product. Transparent decision-making is essential because trust in financial supervision depends as much on institutional independence as regulatory expertise. When policy initiatives appear to originate in political offices while regulators adjust course afterward, the boundary between oversight and political direction inevitably becomes blurred. Foreign media’s portrayal of Korea as an unpredictable investment destination may overstate the case, and government officials are right to point to robust exports, healthy corporate earnings and solid macroeconomic indicators. Yet sound fundamentals cannot fully offset doubts created when financial rules appear vulnerable to shifting political priorities rather than consistent regulatory judgment. That distinction matters because the “Korea discount” has never reflected corporate performance alone. Investors evaluate the credibility of policymaking. Sudden regulatory shifts, emergency interventions and uncertainty over who ultimately directs financial oversight inevitably raise the premium global investors demand. A transparent review of how single-stock leveraged ETFs won approval would therefore strengthen the market rather than weaken it. It should clarify whether internal objections received adequate consideration and whether institutional safeguards functioned as intended. Speculative enthusiasm can lift share prices for a time, but lasting gains depend on institutional credibility. The government is moving to stabilize markets and rebuild confidence. Assuming belated measures can quickly restore trust would itself be another form of political wishful thinking. Former Prime Minister narrowly leads ruling party leadership race Rep. 따라서 단일주식 레버리지 ETF 승인 방식에 대한 투명한 검토는 시장을 약화시키기보다는 강화할 것이다. 내부 이의가 충분한 고려를 받았는지, 그리고 제도적 안전장치가 의도대로 작동했는지를 명확히 해야 한다. 투기적 열기는 한때 주가를 올릴 수 있지만, 지속적인 이득은 제도적 신뢰성에 달려있다. 정부는 시장을 안정화하고 신뢰를 회복하기 위해 조치를 취하고 있다. 늦은 조치들이 신뢰를 빠르게 회복할 수 있다고 가정하는 것은 그 자체로 또 다른 형태의 정치적 낙관론이다.

A balloon effect is occurring as demand shifts to cheaper housing due to increased taxes on high-priced properties.
editorials.bodyTr: The side effects of the tax reform plan announced by the government on the 3rd are becoming evident across the board. Due to increased taxation on non-resident single-home owners, tenants are being forced into a position where they must vacate their homes. As expensive properties, or so-called "solid single homes," become targets of tax increases, demand is shifting to properties in the next lower price bracket, a "less solid single home," creating a balloon effect. According to the reform plan, non-resident single-home owners will see their comprehensive real estate tax basic deduction reduced from 1.2 billion won to 900 million won.

editorials.bodyTr: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan signed a mutual defense pact in Mecca on the 7th. The agreement stipulates that an armed attack on any one country will be considered an attack on all three nations—a provision that closely mirrors NATO's collective defense clause, Article 5.
